attachments.name: 20-0636 Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement - Bay Alarm - District Response & Patrol Services Project - Police Services Department

enrichment.headline: Adds $180,000 and a year to Bay Alarm's burglary alarm response and patrol services
enrichment.summary: This amendment lets Bay Alarm keep providing burglary alarm response and outside patrol, 24 hours a day, seven days a week. It adds $180,000, raising the contract limit from $45,000 to $225,000, and extends the end date from June 30, 2020 to June 30, 2021.

attachments.name: 20-0661 Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy - Fisher & Phillips LLC - General Counsel

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for Fisher & Phillips to handle H-1B visa petitions for teachers hired abroad

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00

enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies a paid engagement with the law firm Fisher & Phillips LLC, set up as a memorandum of understanding and engagement policy. The firm provides immigration advice and prepares and files H-1B visa petitions for District teachers recruited abroad. It runs March 1 to June 30, 2020 and may not exceed $50,000.
